Admission goes through paper. The node prints a code, a bulk mailer envelopes it, and the key activates only when that code returns typed beside the carrier's delivery scan. One street address issues one key a year; a box that forwards mail is void, since forwarding breaks the scan trail.

Fifty clones need fifty rented boxes at 20 dollars monthly, 12,000 a year, plus 0.73 a letter and ten days of waiting per identity before a vote weighs anything. That trail spirals through three carriers.

A garden grows one row per seed, and a glacier keeps one winter per layer.
